problem_type: Exact symbol approvals cannot be represented as file-wide concept consumers
symptom: An approved historical writer tuple still reports pending-unlisted-consumer; adding its whole file would admit unrelated symbol consumers
direct_cause: Consumer schema and matcher accept only a path string
class_root: Approval granularity is lost before comparing the actual AST-generated path and symbol door
affected_population: Pending and forbidden-reference concept consumers in every product host
entry_points: Pending and forbidden-reference actual door policy
internal_only_reason: Nomi concept ownership ratchet and approved consumer declarations are repository-specific governance data.
invariants: Existing string consumer declarations retain their exact current behavior.
An exact record permits only its path and actual generated door symbol; a fourth symbol or different path fails.
Malformed records fail schema validation instead of becoming whole-file permissions.
Pending write-door history and baseline rules are unchanged, even for an exact allowed consumer.

door_reduction.why_not: Validation, sanitization and policy consume the same exact selector through distinct existing checker entry points.

generality_proof: The shared consumer matcher uses actual path/symbol doors for every concept and product host, with no vendor or filename exception.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Preserves the exact consumer selector through registry validation, sanitization or actual door matching.

recurrence.reason: Every future exact approved consumer can be broadened by losing symbol granularity.
same_class_scan: read pending and forbidden-reference consumer matching and schema sanitization

prevention.invariant: Consumer records preserve exact path/symbol identity through the one existing checker.
prevention.failure_mode: Invalid records fail schema; a different actual door remains unlisted.
prevention.strategy: Add a strictly typed exact selector alongside existing string consumer declarations, without changing pending write history.

legacy_paths.rationale: Existing string path consumers remain supported unchanged; broadening a new exact declaration is removed from the matching model.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No third-party dependency or runtime involved.

migration: Only separately approved existing path/symbol tuples will use the exact record form. No history/baseline additions.
residual_risks: Existing inherited desktop owner registration remains advisory and outside this feature scope.
